garment_cutting_table.name: Cutting table and robot tailor
garment_cutting_table.description: Choose SUIT, A-LINE, GOWN or PLEATED and preview the shape. Load committed cloth saved at the Jacquard loom, inspect ten labelled panels, CUT their outlines, ASSEMBLE them one at a time with the robot arm, then WEAR on the real avatar. Shape and cloth persist together; TAKE OFF restores the prior look. Includes tartan, houndstooth and optical samples. Geometric tailoring, not cloth physics or a production sewing draft.
garment_cutting_table.qfep_connection: A retained weave meets a selected cut and an inferred avatar body; exact source data does not make the fit universal.
